landing.faq1Q: How do I make a custom Windows cursor?
landing.faq1A: Upload an image to Pointint, edit the position and hotspot, simulate how it looks, and download Windows-ready cursor files with an install guide.
landing.faq2A: PNG, JPG, WebP, and GIF. Static images become .cur cursor files, while GIFs can become animated .ani cursors.
landing.faq3A: Yes. Upload, edit, simulate, and download - all free, no account required.
landing.faq4Q: How do I apply the cursor to Windows?
landing.faq4A: Extract the downloaded ZIP, right-click install.inf, select "Install", then choose "Pointint" in Mouse Settings > Pointers.
landing.faq5A: The exact pixel where your click registers. Pointint lets you set it visually with a drag tool.
landing.faq6A: Yes. Upload a GIF in the Studio to create and export an animated Windows cursor (.ani).

policy.privacyBody:
Pointint stores only the information required to operate the product, diagnose issues, and understand aggregate usage patterns. If you contact us directly, the information you share is used only to respond and support your request.

We do not require an account to create a cursor. Analytics tools are loaded only after you allow them through the cookie banner.
policy.cookieBody:
Pointint uses essential cookies to remember interface state that is necessary for the site to work. If you allow analytics cookies, Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity may also be loaded to help us understand product usage and improve the experience.

You can choose between essential-only use and full analytics consent from the cookie banner.
policy.termsBody:
Pointint is provided as-is for creating custom cursor assets. You are responsible for the images you upload and for making sure you have the right to use them.

Do not use the service to upload illegal content, malicious files, or material that infringes on the rights of others. We may update or remove parts of the service as the product evolves.
